description:
FILED s521a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from #3362's acceptance run (scratch/s521a/comp1.log, one-file companion on b3b78946).

#3362 (s520 ruling (1) = (a)) made `B::CV::CvFLAGS` answer CVf_ANON / CVf_LVALUE / CVf_METHOD, so op/stash.t's CvFLAGS rows (79 / 91 / 103) PASS now -- but the file then reaches line 143:

    $gv = B::svref_2object($sub)->GV;
    is $gv->STASH->NAME, '__ANON__',
     'CV anonymised when its stash is detached becomes __ANON__::__ANON__';

UNGUARDED (no eval).  lib/B.pm's `B::GV::STASH` for a sub with no recorded name dies "B::GV::STASH of an anonymous sub is not supported by PCL (the package an anonymous sub was compiled in is not recorded ...)" (#3281's designed die) and that ABORTS the file.  Measured (perl / C before / C after):
  op/stash.t   P 54/1   C 20/7 (main since #3281)  ->  C 31/12 (s521a)   [pre-#3281 snapshot 48/7: the B block was SKIPPED because `require B` failed]
  uni/stash.t  P 48/1   C 17/6                     ->  C 28/11            [snapshot 43/6]
The 5 + 5 extra fails are honest: `eval { $gv->STASH->NAME }` rows (81 / 93 "...but leaves stash intact" expect "one" / "two"; 105 "...and an __ANON__ stash") answer undef because the die is trapped.

The question (rule 12's value-consumed boundary, as #3362's was): perl's answer for an anonymous sub's GV->STASH is the COMPILING package ("main" for `sub {}` in main), and "__ANON__" once that stash was deleted.  PCL records neither.  Shapes:
  (a) record the compiling package of an anonymous sub (p-sub / the anon lambda already knows *package* at definition -- a runtime fact like builtin::sub_name; then GV->STASH answers it, and a deleted stash could answer __ANON__ if stash deletion is tracked) -- real work, the right answer;
  (b) answer "__ANON__" for every anonymous sub's GV->STASH (a guess: wrong for ordinary anon subs, where perl says the package) -- NOT recommended;
  (c) keep the die (status quo after #3362): op/stash.t 31/12, uni/stash.t 28/11, the companion baselines edited to those numbers citing this task.
s521a shipped (c) as the interim and edited the companion rows citing #3362 + this task.
subject: RULING WANTED: op/stash.t:143 + uni/stash.t call `$gv->STASH->NAME` UNGUARDED on the GV of an anonymised sub; lib/B.pm dies by design (the package an anonymous sub was compiled in is not recorded) and ABORTS both files after #3362 -- 31/12 and 28/11 against the pre-#3281 snapshot 48/7 and 43/6
